crossRefs.note: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, and don’t set their top among…
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
crossRefs.keyword: and fall, etc.Or, "as fall as one of them, O ye princes."

translations.web: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”
translations.bsb: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
translations.kjv: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
translations.asv: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.
